ZentisRefRegistry.note: Oracle band disabled (FEED = address(0)). CORRECTION: the note previously here said the Base Sepolia ETH/USD feed is access-gated against contract reads. It is not. latestRoundData at 0x4aDC67696bA383F43DD60A9e78F2C97Fbbfc7cb1 returned $2465.88 at 2026-09-11T06:47Z over the public RPC, within 20 bps of the mainnet market mid. The band stays disabled because FEED is immutable and enabling it means new registries, new strategy hashes, a re-ship and new subgraph manifests. Redeployed so the on-chain bytecode matches the repository: the superseded instance predates the fix that makes onReport reject rather than revert.
ZentisRefRegistry.ethUsdFeedVerified: 2026-09-11, latestRoundData read over the public RPC

referencePool.supersededNote: SUPERSEDED as a price source on 2026-09-11: the legs no longer quote from this pool. Every leg now prices from one mid read from the real WETH/USDC market on Ethereum mainnet, because three unarbitraged testnet pools quoted the same pair at three unrelated prices and a book weight measured against one of them is not comparable with a weight measured against another. Kept as the record of what this leg used to price from, and of the liquidity criterion the chain was chosen on.
referencePool.keyNote: Recorded as supersededAddress rather than address on purpose: the console reads referencePool.address as a live endpoint, and a retired pool must not become one again by being written down. Sepolia's record still carries address because its chart has not been repointed yet.
referencePool.note: Carried a volatilityMultiplierBps override of 3000 in the slow workflow, because one sigma on this series pinned the spread at its cap. Removed with the series: on the real market sigma over the 60-second cadence is 2 bps and the global multiplier is correct.

position.note: Balances here are the shipped amounts; live balances come from the fills subgraph.

fills.note: 1% of inventory, sized so the curve stays well inside the band.

note: Every hash here was resolved from an on-chain receipt, not from the position of an entry in forge run-latest.json -- that file lists transactions[].hash in an order that does not match its own function labels.
aquaCustody: ship() and dock() move no tokens: Aqua records a balance and pulls from the maker's wallet at settlement time, against the maker's approval. The Aqua contract's own token balance is zero. Funds never leave the maker's wallet.

creWritePath.note: The real IReceiver surface, exercised on-chain before any CRE workflow exists: forwarder gating, the ABI decode, the write guards and the event. Only the attestation is missing, and that is what Day 5 simulates.
creWritePath.replayedResult: status 0x1 -- did not revert; emitted ZentisRefRejected(positionId, "stale seq") and left the stored ref untouched, which is what stops a DON retrying a doomed report forever
creWritePath.outOfGasNote: An earlier attempt at the accepted write failed with gasUsed == gas limit == 39473. That was cast's gas estimate being too low, not a contract revert. Pass an explicit --gas-limit for onReport.

fills.note: The fill that drove the cross-chain demonstration: it left Base 69.2% USDC against Arbitrum's 54.8%, which the next reference published as +36 bps on Base and -36 bps on Arbitrum.
The first fill in this direction. An identical attempt before the top-up was refused on-chain by ZentisBand with ZentisOutsideBand(2.229e26, 2.614e26, false).
